separate_profiles.name: SPIN_PLUS_ANTE
separate_profiles.reason: Different forced ante structure; GTO Wizard describes Spin+Ante as a distinct solution family with per-player ante. Never share canonical routes or charts with Regular Spin.

separate_profiles.name: HIGH_MULTIPLIER_ICM
separate_profiles.reason: When 2nd/3rd receive prizes, ICM is present. Never use WTA/ChipEV charts for these payout profiles.

separate_profiles.name: ASYMMETRIC_STACKS
separate_profiles.reason: A single effective-stack label is not sufficient to identify solver strategy when the three seat stacks differ. Store exact BTN/SB/BB stacks in source metadata for asymmetric libraries.

separate_profiles.name: SPIN_HU
separate_profiles.reason: Heads-up is a distinct player-count/action-tree profile.

source_evidence.supports: Lower multipliers are winner-take-all; high multipliers paying 2nd/3rd introduce ICM.
Winner-take-all tournament is essentially a chip-EV contest / bubble factor 1.
Regular and Spin+Ante are separate; Spin+Ante uses 0.17bb ante/player in the announced family; current high-accuracy General/Simple trees replace legacy solutions.
Regular Spin supports Research/General/Simple; Research is intended for optimal preflop sizing study; regular Spin study extends deeper than the old 25bb library.

capture_rejection_rules: Reject Spin+Ante capture when primary profile expects ante NONE.
Reject high-multiplier/ICM capture when primary profile expects WTA_CHIPEV_BASELINE.
Reject asymmetric-stack capture unless exact BTN/SB/BB stacks are represented by a dedicated asymmetric profile.
Reject Legacy/Basic as a new 2026 primary source.
Reject a capture that omits any legal preflop action or exact sizing present in the selected Research node.
